name: Parking Agent
description: Finds parking lots, car parks, and parking garages. Searches near the current position or a specified city, address, street, or landmark.

skills.name: Find Nearby Parking
skills.description: Finds parking lots, car parks, parking spaces, and parking garages near current position or a specified location. Supports an optional search radius and returns parking names and addresses.
examples: find parking near my current location
where can I park near Wawel Castle?
find places where I can park my car near me
find a parking garage in London
